hops.detail: Origination passes AccountOpening.AccountId into account get/create/open request IDs.
The processor consumes TMV Account events and copies AccountEvent.Account.Id to the Profile change set; service-level identity continuity is not runtime verified.
The producer event contract and consumer product correspond by schema/product evidence, but the consumer topic is supplied by Secret Manager and its runtime value is absent from the source snapshot.

limitations: Kafka topic names/consumer secret values are not in the repository snapshot; producer-consumer continuity is not runtime verified.
Only event schema JSON paths exactly matched to SQL extraction expressions are linked.
AccountOpening-to-TMV AccountEvent identity continuity crosses an external API/event service and remains unverified.
